column1: # Hand-kept status of exe functions for the registry (python3 -m tools.exe.registry -> docs/registry.tsv). These win
# over the automatic guesses (citations in core/ and docs/). One row per function: addr<TAB>name<TAB>status<TAB>note.
# name: a descriptive name (empty: keep the dump's). status:
#   implemented  the port does what it does (core/, port choices noted)
#   partial      the port does part of it, or an approximation (note says what is missing)
#   stub         the port has a placeholder that does nothing (or a constant)
#   known        read and understood (docs), not ported
# Keep notes short; the docs hold the detail (docs/CAMERA.md "Fifth pass" for the camera rows).
